stories.title: Indian markets rise in Muhurat trading as Sensex up 320 points, Nifty above 25,100
stories.summary: On Sunday, November 8, the Indian stock market opened higher in a special Muhurat trading session marking the start of Samvat 2083. The Sensex rose about 320 points at the opening bell and the Nifty moved above the 25,100 level after closing Friday at 25,030.35. Tata Steel and Sun Pharma were among the top gainers.
stories.why: The advance gives a positive start to Samvat 2083, supporting market confidence.

stories.title: Diwali turned lucky for these 8 stocks! Investors' wealth more than doubled, returns soar up to 191%
stories.summary: A select group of 8 BSE 500 stocks delivered exceptional returns since Diwali 2025, more than doubling investors' wealth with gains of up to 191%, even as the Nifty 50 declined nearly 3%. Aditya Infotech led the list of top-performing BSE 500 stocks, delivering an impressive return of 191.39% since Diwali 2025, according to ACE Equities data.
